## Shedu (CR 7)

**XP** 3,200  
LG Large magical beast  
**Init** +5; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +13  


**Defense**


**AC** 16, touch 10, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +6 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 76 (9d10+27)  
**Fort** +9, **Ref** +7, **Will** +8  
**Defensive Abilities** **SR** 16  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., fly 60 ft. (average)  
**Melee** 2 hooves +14 (1d6+5)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Spell-like Abilities** (CL 9th) (save DC 13 + spell level)  

At will—astral projection (self only), detect evil, detect thoughts  
3/day—charm monster (DC 17)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 21, **Dex** 12, **Con** 17, **Int** 16, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 17  
**Base Atk** +9; **CMB** +15; **CMD** 26 (30 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Blind-Fight, Flyby Attack, Improved Initiative, Iron Will, [Weapon Focus (hoof)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (hoof).*  
**Skills** Diplomacy +15, Knowledge (arcana) +15, Knowledge (planes) +15, Fly +9, Perception +13, Sense Motive +14; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Diplomacy, +4 Knowledge (any two), +4 Sense Motive  
**Languages** Celestial, Common, Draconic; telepathy 100 ft.  
**SQ** ethereal jaunt  


**Special Abilities**


**Ethereal Jaunt (Su)** A shedu can shift from the Ethereal Plane to the Material Plane as a free action, and shift back again as a move-equivalent action. This ability is otherwise identical with the ethereal jaunt spell (caster level 18th).  



**Variants**


Greater Shedu

**Ecology**


**Environment** any warm land  
**Organization** herd (2-8)  
**Treasure** standard
